boards.school_name: Nebraska Methodist College of Nursing & Allied Health
boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Nebraska Methodist College spaces with documented study, gathering, wellness, reflection, or academic-support uses.

cards.title: Learning & Academic Resource Commons
cards.subtitle: Clark Center, second floor
cards.notes: Set up at a booth, couch, table, or lounge seat, then use the nearby academic-support resources when you need a focused work session.
cards.short_summary: A shared academic commons with individual and collaborative seating.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC says the LARC has collaborative group and individual study spaces, including lounge seating, couches, booths, and tables, plus academic resources.
cards.source_title: Nebraska Methodist College opens new Learning and Academic Resource Commons
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor of the Clark Center; use is oriented to NMC students and academic resources.

cards.title: John Moritz Library
cards.subtitle: Learning & Academic Resource Commons, Clark Center
cards.notes: Choose a single-person booth for quiet reading or use the group-work area and Apple TV when your assignment calls for shared review.
cards.short_summary: The campus library combines borrowing, reference materials, and adaptable study seating.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC reports that the library in the LARC has updated study spaces, an Apple TV and group-work space, single-person booths, books, reference resources, and laptops.
cards.source_title: Nebraska Methodist College opens new Learning and Academic Resource Commons
cards.access_notes: NMC states that students may use the library after hours with badge access.

cards.title: Katherine Shreffler Student Center
cards.subtitle: Clark Center
cards.notes: Use the tables or gathering furnishings to meet classmates, review notes, or warm a packed meal in the enclosed dining area.
cards.short_summary: A furnished gathering and study space with basic meal-storage and heating amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC describes the Katherine Shreffler Student Center as having furnishings for student gatherings, meetings, and studying, plus an enclosed dining area with refrigerators, microwave, sink, and tables.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Clark Center; the listed computers, printer, and scanner are identified for student use.

cards.title: Student Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Clark Center, second floor
cards.notes: Bring a small group or work solo; each room has a whiteboard and computer, with a nearby printer for course materials.
cards.short_summary: Ten dedicated rooms support quiet individual and small-group study.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC lists ten quiet study rooms on the Clark Center's second floor, each equipped with a whiteboard and computer; students may use them individually or in small groups.
cards.access_notes: Second-floor Clark Center study rooms; confirm availability locally before planning a group session.

cards.title: Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Clark Center
cards.notes: Use a campus workstation when you need printing, scanning, a webcam, or headphones instead of relying on your own device.
cards.short_summary: A campus computer space with printing, scanning, and audio-video peripherals.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC says its computer lab offers student access to photocopiers, printers, scanners, DVD players, audio-equipped webcams, headsets, and headphones.
cards.access_notes: NMC identifies the listed technology as available to all students.

cards.title: Wellness Engagement Center
cards.subtitle: Clark Center, first floor
cards.notes: Fit in a cardio or strength session, try the group fitness studio, or take a recovery break using the massage chairs.
cards.short_summary: The campus fitness center provides exercise and recovery equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC describes the Wellness Engagement Center as a first-floor Clark Center fitness center with cardio and strength equipment, massage chairs, and a group fitness studio.
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of the Clark Center.

cards.title: The Chapel
cards.subtitle: Nebraska Methodist College campus
cards.notes: Step into the circular room for a quiet pause, personal reflection, prayer, or a small study conversation with a friend.
cards.short_summary: A reflective campus space shaped around quiet individual or group use.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC describes the Chapel as a place to think, reflect, pray, meet with friends, or take part in prayer or study; it includes stained glass and a water wall.
cards.access_notes: Use respectfully as a reflective and spiritual space.

cards.title: Nourishment Center
cards.subtitle: Learning & Academic Resource Commons
cards.notes: Take a study break for the snacks or coffee noted by NMC, then return to the commons seating with your materials.
cards.short_summary: A LARC refreshment area documented with free snacks and coffee.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC states that the LARC commons area includes a student nourishment area with free snacks and coffee.
cards.source_title: Nebraska Methodist College opens new Learning and Academic Resource Commons
cards.access_notes: Located within the LARC commons area; availability may vary.

cards.title: Nursing Skills Laboratory
cards.subtitle: Riley Leinart Center
cards.notes: Use this named instructional setting during scheduled nursing learning activities; coordinate with your course faculty for lab-specific expectations.
cards.short_summary: A named nursing instructional laboratory in the Riley Leinart Center.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC identifies the Riley Leinart Center as housing classrooms and the Nursing Skills Laboratory.
cards.access_notes: Instructional laboratory; access and activity are course-directed.

cards.title: 501 Center
cards.subtitle: Nebraska Methodist College campus
cards.notes: Locate this named campus building when your program directs you to imaging labs or when you need to connect with Student Health.
cards.short_summary: A campus building that houses imaging labs and Student Health.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC identifies the 501 Center as home to its imaging labs and Student Health.
cards.access_notes: Use imaging labs and Student Health according to program or service procedures.
